title: Brand Manifest
name: dev.uap.common.brand
description: Served at `GET /.well-known/uap-brand` by every advertiser. Establishes which domains an advertiser may link to and who is accountable for the creative.
$comment:
Referenced by creative review since draft-01 but never defined, which meant the one check that stops click laundering had no schema behind it. An action URL that does not resolve to a domain listed here is rejected at review; redirect chains are followed and re-checked, so a creative cannot be approved against one destination and later serve another.

This is the advertiser-side counterpart to uap-sellers.json. Together they close the loop: a buyer can see who is selling, and a seller can see who is buying.

advertiser_id.description: Stable identifier, matching `advertiser.id` on every creative.

display_name.description: Name shown to users in the disclosure. May differ from the legal name.

verified_domains.description: Domains this advertiser may direct clicks to. Subdomains are included.
verified_domains.$comment: Verified by the exchange at enrolment, by DNS TXT record or by serving this manifest over TLS at the apex. An unverified domain in an action URL is `url_not_verified_domain` at review.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166 code of the entity's registration.

identifiers.description: Third-party identity assertions, so an exchange can tie the brand to a contractable entity.

categories.description: Categories this advertiser operates in. Sellers block on these.

keys.description: JWKS URL. Conversion reports are signed with a key from it.

policy_contact.description: Where creative rejections and policy appeals are sent.
